prior_art.reason: Prior art searched on 2026-11-12. Printables 'USB Extension Cord WiFi Dongle Stand' (265738) and its M4 remix (1191970) exist. This design is kept because it is sized to the TP-Link UB500 Plus (adapter pocket, plug relief, antenna end left open) and carries a countersunk M4 mount and a test-fit coupon. Nothing was copied from either listing.

devices.name: tp-link-ub500-plus
devices.source: padded estimate from TP-Link's published 81 x 42 x 16.8 mm envelope (whole product with fold-out antenna); body length 45 and width 24 are generous guesses, height 16.8 is published, plus 0.6 mm clearance per side. The test-fit coupon is mandatory before the full perch.

params.notes: pocket width (adapter_body_width + 2*clearance) is open-top, so stl_measure sees it as a gap between wall loops, not a hole; tests/python/test_bt_antenna_perch_coupon.py pins it from the mesh
